title: SOCRATIC-PRMBENCH: Benchmarking Process Reward Models with Systematic Reasoning Patterns
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the logical reasoning and mathematical problem-solving capabilities of Process Reward Models (PRMs). While it is inspired by the logical theories of the philosopher Socrates, it applies these categories solely to technical reasoning patterns (e.g., Transformation, Deduction) rather than evaluating religious, ethical, or moral dimensions.
